# SwiftMandarin — Implementation Brief: OCR Language Fix, Multi-Provider AI, Photo AI Cleanup

## 1. Overall Architecture

SwiftMandarin is a cross-platform (iOS + macOS) SwiftUI Mandarin-learning app. State lives in **`@Observable @MainActor` singletons** (`.shared`) backed by **UserDefaults JSON blobs** — there is no SwiftData/CoreData in active use (`Item.swift` is a dead template stub). The five core stores (`SavedTermsStore`, `TranslationHistoryStore`, `LearningProgressStore`, `LearningActivityStore`, `AppRouteStore`) are constructed in `SwiftMandarinApp.swift` and injected via `.environment(...)`; **`AIModelSettings.shared` is NOT injected** — it is reached as a singleton inside views, an inconsistency to preserve.

Four functional pillars matter here:
- **OCR/Vision** — `PhotoTextRecognitionService` (one `VNRecognizeTextRequest`), fed by 3 independent recognition paths (photo picker, live `DataScannerViewController` camera, screenshot stitch).
- **Language detection/routing** — fragmented across **3+ duplicated detectors** (`PhotoTranslateView.detectLanguage`, `ChineseTextAnalyzer.detectLanguage`, `EnglishTextAnalyzer.detectLanguage`, plus naive `containsChinese` scans in `TranslateView`/`LiveSpeechTranslationView`). The only character-level CJK primitive is `Character.isChineseCharacter` (`ChineseTextAnalyzer.swift:184`).
- **AI/LLM** — `AIProvider` enum (**2 cases only**) + `AIModelSettings` (Ollama-shaped config) → `AIWordExplanationService` (the dispatch switch) → `OllamaService` (the only network client, wrapping third-party `Ollama.Client`).
- **Translation** — Apple Translation framework (`TranslationSession`) hardcoded to `en` ↔ `zh-Hans`, plus per-word `WordTranslationService`.

App Intents/Shortcuts wrap these via stable singleton signatures and must not be broken by refactors.

---

## 2. CONCERN A — Photo gibberish + stuck on English (VERIFIED root cause)

### Root-cause hypothesis (confirmed by reading the source)
A **compounding 4-stage failure**, all upstream-to-downstream reinforcing "English":

1. **`PhotoTextRecognitionService.swift:204`** — `request.recognitionLanguages = ["en-US", "en-GB", "zh-Hans", "zh-Hant"]` with English **first**, and `request.automaticallyDetectsLanguage` is **never set**. On `VNRecognizeTextRequestRevision3` (line 211), supplying an explicit `recognitionLanguages` array suppresses auto-detection and treats the order as a strong prior. There is **no per-call parameter** — the literal is fixed, so the feature genuinely "cannot switch languages."
2. **`PhotoTextRecognitionService.swift:207`** — `usesLanguageCorrection = true` unconditionally. English autocorrection mangles Chinese glyphs into Latin-looking gibberish.
3. **`PhotoTextRecognitionService.swift:45-72`** (and duplicated at `PhotoTranslateView.swift:601-621`, `CameraScannerView.swift:123-143`) — `cleanTextForSentences` is English-centric: collapses all whitespace to single spaces, strips `"- "`, inserts spaces around `[A-Z]` after `.?!`. Damaging for spaceless full-width-punctuation Chinese.
4. **`PhotoTranslateView.swift:573-598`** — `detectLanguage` runs **after** OCR on already-English-biased text. The CJK-ratio fallback (`chineseCharCount > text.count/3`, line 593) only fires in the `default` branch, so when `NLLanguageRecognizer` confidently returns `.english`, it never runs. `.unknown`/non-Chinese **falls back to English** (lines 561-568, 596). `TextRecognitionResult.language` is hardwired `nil` (line 40), so detected language is never carried downstream.

Secondary: `CameraScannerView.swift:39-47` uses `.text()` with **no** language hint (2nd locked path); `VNImageRequestHandler(cgImage:options:[:])` at line 214 ignores EXIF orientation.

### Exact files / lines / APIs to change
- **`PhotoTextRecognitionService.performRecognition` (lines 200-214)** — make `recognitionLanguages` and `usesLanguageCorrection` **parameters** of `recognizeText(...)`. Best fix: run a cheap detection pass (low-cost OCR or `NLLanguageRecognizer` over a fast first pass), then re-OCR with the detected language **first** (`["zh-Hans","zh-Hant","en-US"]` for Chinese), and set `usesLanguageCorrection = false` for CJK. Pass image **orientation** into `VNImageRequestHandler` (line 214).
- **Populate `TextRecognitionResult.language` (line 40)** so detection result flows downstream.
- **Consolidate the 3 detectors** into one shared function (extend `ChineseTextAnalyzer.detectLanguage`, `ChineseTextAnalyzer.swift:60`) that checks `Character.isChineseCharacter` **ratio first** (the helper already exists at line 184), then consults `NLLanguageRecognizer`. Repoint `PhotoTranslateView.detectLanguage` (573), `ShortcutHelpers.resolveDirection` (34), and `EnglishTextAnalyzer.isEnglish` (405) at it. Remove the English-default fallback in `PhotoTranslateView` (561-568, 596).
- **Skip English cleaners for Chinese** — branch `cleanTextForSentences`/`cleanTextForProcessing` on detected language.
- **`CameraScannerView.swift:40`** — use `.text(languages:)` with the selected/detected language array.
- Widen `Character.isChineseCharacter` (line 184) to include CJK Compatibility Ideographs (0xF900-0xFAFF) and full-width punctuation.

A UI affordance (manual language override in `PhotoTranslateView`'s toolbar `Menu`, lines 102-120) should accompany the auto-detect so the user can force Chinese.

---

## 3. CONCERN B — Multi-provider AI with API-fetched model lists

### Current abstraction (verified)
- **`AIProvider`** (`AIModelSettings.swift:15-47`): closed 2-case enum (`.appleIntelligence="apple"`, `.ollama="ollama"`), `CaseIterable` — both Settings pickers `ForEach(AIProvider.allCases)` auto-render new cases.
- **`AIModelSettings`** (`AIModelSettings.swift:54-213`): Ollama-shaped fields only (`ollamaModel`, `ollamaHost`, `enableThinking`, `contextLength`), UserDefaults Keys (60-66). **No `apiKey` field, no Keychain anywhere in the codebase.** `effectiveProvider` (123-130) and `statusMessage` (133-152) are exhaustive 2-case switches. `ollamaOptions` (155-163) returns `[String: Ollama.Value]` — SDK-coupled.
- **`OllamaService`** — the only network client; `refreshModels()` (110-152) is the existing "pull model list from API" pattern (`client.listModels()` + per-model `showModel` capability probe). **Blocker:** the third-party `Ollama.Client` init takes only `(session, host, userAgent)`, `createRequest()` hardcodes `/api/*` paths and sets **no Authorization header** — it **cannot** reach cloud APIs.
- **`AIWordExplanationService`** — dispatch chokepoint: `generateExplanationWithProvider` (388-401) and `translateWithProvider` (408-417) are 2-case switches on `settings.effectiveProvider`. `OllamaWordExplanationResponse` decode is strict (no markdown-fence tolerance).
- **`ShortcutHelpers.aiIsAvailable()` (95)** and `AIWordExplanationView.isAnyProviderAvailable (27)** also hardcode `Apple || Ollama`.

### Concrete plan
1. **Extend `AIProvider`** with `.openAI`, `.anthropic`, `.deepseek`, `.doubao`, `.qwen`, `.kimi`, `.zhipu`, `.minimax`. Add `displayName`/`description`/`iconName`/`defaultBaseURL` per case. Most are **OpenAI-compatible** (`/v1/chat/completions` + `/v1/models`); **Anthropic differs** (`/v1/messages`, `x-api-key` + `anthropic-version` headers).
2. **Introduce a provider protocol** to generalize `OllamaService`'s surface:
   ```swift
   protocol AIProviderClient {
       func listModels() async throws -> [ModelInfo]
       func chatStructured(system: String, user: String, schema: JSONSchema?, image: Data?) async throws -> String
       func translate(_ text: String, sourceIsChinese: Bool) async throws -> String
   }
   ```
   Implement `OpenAICompatibleClient` (covers OpenAI/Deepseek/Doubao/Qwen-DashScope/Kimi-Moonshot/Zhipu/Minimax via per-provider baseURL + Bearer auth) and `AnthropicClient`. Each is **URLSession-based** (do NOT reuse `Ollama.Client`). Add a provider-neutral `ModelInfo` (generalize `OllamaModelInfo`) and tolerant JSON extraction (strip ```json fences, find first `{...}`) for `AIWordExplanationService.swift:538`.
3. **Model-list fetching**: replicate `refreshConnection()`/`refreshModels()` per provider via `GET {baseURL}/v1/models` (OpenAI-compatible) — the Settings `Picker(ForEach availableModels)` UI is **already built and reusable**. Store per-provider `selectedModel` + `availableModels` maps in `AIModelSettings`.
4. **Secure key storage**: add a **Keychain** wrapper (none exists today). Add per-provider `apiKey` accessors to `AIModelSettings`; surface as `SecureField` in **both** settings views.
5. **Settings UI** (must change in parity): macOS `AISettingsTab` (`MacOSSettingsView.swift:106-287`, hardcoded `if provider == .ollama` at 142, `.appleIntelligence` at 249) and iOS `AISettingsDetailView` (`MoreView.swift:276-478`, branches at 329/433). Extract a **shared provider-config subview** (API key + base URL + model picker + refresh) to avoid iOS/macOS drift. Update footer strings (`MacOSSettingsView.swift:138`, `MoreView.swift:195`).
6. **Generalize all exhaustive switches** (compiler will enumerate them): `effectiveProvider`, `statusMessage`/`statusColor` (`AIModelSettings.swift:124-152`, `MacOSSettingsView.swift:279`, `MoreView.swift:470`), the two dispatch switches in `AIWordExplanationService`, `aiIsAvailable()` (`ShortcutHelpers.swift:95`), and `isAnyProviderAvailable` (`AIWordExplanationView.swift:27`). "Available" for cloud = non-empty API key + reachable endpoint. Replace the force-unwrap `Ollama.Model.ID(rawValue:)!` pattern (`OllamaService.swift:126,171,197,230`) for arbitrary cloud model IDs.

---

## 4. CONCERN C — Photo AI cleanup toggle (depends on B's plumbing)

### Exact integration seam
**Primary (single-image path):** `PhotoTranslateView.loadAndProcessImage()` — between `recognizeText(from: data)` (**line 508**) and `sourceText = result.cleanedText` (**line 512**). When the toggle is ON, route `result.fullText` (or, for vision-capable providers, the raw `data`/image) to the selected provider's cleanup method, then substitute the cleaned/structured text before `processText()`.

**Secondary (screenshot path):** `ScreenshotTranslationStore.processScreenshots()` — the `recognizeText(in: stitched.image)` call (`ScreenshotTranslationStore.swift:172`) can branch to a vision model that takes the stitched `UIImage`/`NSImage` directly and returns structured text, skipping Vision OCR entirely. Because `TranslateScreenshotsIntent` hands all images through `ScreenshotTranslationStore.shared`, **no intent-layer change is needed** if cleanup is injected inside the store.

### Data flow & required pieces
1. **New `@Observable` flag** `aiPhotoCleanupEnabled` in `AIModelSettings` (UserDefaults-backed via `didSet`, mirroring existing properties).
2. **Toggle UI** in `PhotoTranslateView`'s toolbar `Menu` (lines 102-120, alongside `showGrammarPoints`) AND in the AI/Translation settings tabs for discoverability.
3. **New method on `AIWordExplanationService`** — `cleanupRecognizedText(_:) -> String` (text) or `cleanupPhoto(image:) -> String` (vision), routed through the **same expanded `effectiveProvider` switch** from Concern B. The protocol's `chatStructured(..., image:)` parameter is what enables true vision cleanup — OpenAI/Claude/Qwen-VL/Doubao accept base64 image inputs in the chat payload.
4. **`VocabularyImportExportService`** is the natural ingestion point if cleanup returns structured vocab.

**Hard dependency:** `OllamaService`/Apple paths are text-only with no image input today. Concern C's vision branch is **blocked on Concern B's** custom URLSession request builders with multimodal support.

## 5. Prioritized implementation plan with risk notes

**Phase 0 — Shared language detector (unblocks A; low risk, high leverage)**
Build one CJK-ratio-first detector in `ChineseTextAnalyzer.detectLanguage` (helper exists at line 184). Repoint `PhotoTranslateView.detectLanguage`, `ShortcutHelpers.resolveDirection`, `EnglishTextAnalyzer.isEnglish`. *Risk:* changing shortcut routing direction — test the auto-direction Shortcuts flow.

**Phase 1 — OCR language fix (Concern A core; medium risk)**
Parameterize `recognitionLanguages`/`usesLanguageCorrection` in `PhotoTextRecognitionService`; add detect-then-reOCR; pass orientation; populate `TextRecognitionResult.language`; branch the English cleaners; fix `CameraScannerView` `.text(languages:)`; add manual override UI. *Risk:* detect-then-reOCR doubles OCR cost — gate behind a fast first pass; Vision behavior varies by OS revision. **This is the user's most acute complaint — ship first.**

**Phase 2 — Provider abstraction + Keychain (Concern B foundation; high risk/effort)**
Define `AIProviderClient` protocol + `ModelInfo`; extend `AIProvider` enum; add Keychain wrapper + per-provider config to `AIModelSettings`; implement `OpenAICompatibleClient` + `AnthropicClient` with URLSession; tolerant JSON parsing. *Risk:* `Ollama.Client` cannot be reused (verified blocker) — all cloud clients are net-new; every exhaustive `AIProvider` switch breaks at compile time (use as a checklist, don't suppress).

**Phase 3 — Settings UI parity (Concern B surface; medium risk)**
Extract shared provider-config subview; update `AISettingsTab` + `AISettingsDetailView`, status switches, footer strings; per-provider model refresh reusing the existing Picker. *Risk:* iOS/macOS drift — the shared subview is mandatory, not optional.

**Phase 4 — Photo AI cleanup (Concern C; medium risk, depends on Phase 2/3)**
Add `aiPhotoCleanupEnabled` + toggle UI; add `cleanupRecognizedText`/`cleanupPhoto` to `AIWordExplanationService`; hook the seam at `PhotoTranslateView.swift:508-512` (and optionally `ScreenshotTranslationStore.swift:172`). *Risk:* injecting cleaned text into `sharedState.sourceText` can trip `TranslateView`'s `onChange` clear logic (`TranslateView.swift:276-296, 1011-1017`) — verify the injection path.

**Cross-cutting risks:** No model/schema versioning on any UserDefaults blob — new `SavedTerm`/settings fields **must be optional-with-defaults** or existing data silently drops (`TranslationHistory.swift:109` swallows decode errors). `WordTranslationService.translationCache` is a data race (non-`@MainActor` mutated async) — fix before adding network providers. Several `print()`-only error swallows (`ShortcutHelpers.swift:52`, `VocabularyView.swift:774-789`) will hide provider/API-key failures — add real error surfacing.
